description:
List proxy sub-accounts (wraps developer-api POST /v1/proxy_account/list).

**Best for:** auditing sub-accounts, finding account names before rotating credentials.
**Params:** product (REQUIRED — same codes as create), page, limit (max 200), status? ("1"|"-3"), account? (exact-match filter).
**Wire format:** multipart/form-data.
**Auth:** NOVADA_DEVELOPER_API_KEY (falls back to NOVADA_API_KEY).

account.description: Optional filter — exact-match account name. (API field is `account`, not `username`.)

limit.description: Entries per page, max 200. (API field is `limit`, not `page_size`.)

product.description: REQUIRED. Product type code as string: 1=Residential, 2=Rotating ISP, 3=Rotating Datacenter, 4=Unlimited, 7=Unblocker, 9=Mobile. Must match a product provisioned on the account.

status.description: Optional filter: "1" = active, "-3" = disabled. Omit for both.

name: novada_proxy_account_list
title: Proxy Account List
